map.由名义值与通胀率求实际值: Finding the real value from the nominal value and the inflation rate
map.输入名义值 Nominal 与通胀率 π，求实际值。: Enter the nominal value and the inflation rate π to get the real value.
map.📖 查看「由名义值与通胀率求实际值 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Finding the Real Value from the Nominal Value and the Inflation Rate Usage Guide"
map.📚 深度解析：由名义值与通胀率求实际值: 📚 Deep Dive: Finding the Real Value from the Nominal Value and the Inflation Rate
map.实际化：录入名义值与通胀率，算实际值（购买力）。: Making it real: enter the nominal value and the inflation rate to get the real value (purchasing power).
map.工资研判：名义工资除通胀看实际工资涨跌。: Wage assessment: divide the nominal wage by inflation to see whether real wages rise or fall.
map.教学演示：演示高通胀下名义增但实际降。: Teaching demo: show that under high inflation the nominal value rises while the real one falls.
map.示例：名义工资 11000、通胀 10%，实际=11000/1.1=10000，: Example: a nominal wage of 11,000 with 10% inflation gives a real wage of 11000/1.1 = 10000, so purchasing power is unchanged.
map.GDP 用 GDP 平减指数、消费用 CPI，按对象选对应通胀指标。结果仅作经济: Use the GDP deflator for GDP and CPI for consumption, choosing the price index that matches the object. map.实际利率≈名义−通胀，与本工具的 deflation 同思路。结果仅作经济学教学: the real rate ≈ nominal − inflation, the same idea as the deflation in this tool. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
